purpose: Output-level voice contract for the collective current-sky aspect cards. These rules apply to RENDERED card copy, not to source meaning in data/, so they are stricter than voice/banned-words.json (which the build enforces against data). Enforced by scripts/lint-sky-voice.mjs.
voiceDescription: Direct, grounded, and modern, like advice from the reader's smartest, most honest friend. Names what is actually happening before it explains any astrology. Collective in subject; direct you/your guidance is allowed after the shared condition is clear, but standing personality claims are not. Felt but never corporate or mystical. Short, quotable sentences; ends on a plain truth.
lockedPrinciple: The astrology should explain why the event unfolds the way it does, while the prose shows what that looks like in ordinary life. The best version does both.
personNote: Collective sky aspects are written primarily in first-person-plural ('we', 'us', 'our'), the standard register for mundane/current-sky writing (cf. Cafe Astrology: 'we more readily tap into our deeper ambitions'). This names the collective as US and describes the shared experience, inner and outer. Third person ('people', 'the whole field') is a secondary option. Second person ('you', 'your') stays banned on this surface. Every card must establish the collective subject up front and never drift into a floating two-person vignette.

punctuation.emDash: The em dash is banned. Use a spaced hyphen ' - ' instead.
punctuation.example: knowing when the work is complete - not perfect, but complete

metaphorGuidance.note: Metaphors stay concrete and rare. Generic or mismatched metaphors are still cut (weather-as-mood, walls, machinery). But ELEMENTAL metaphors are welcome when they match the element of a planet or sign in the card - this is astrologically apt, not decoration. Water imagery is right for a Neptune card; fire imagery is right for a Sun/Leo card.
examples: Neptune trine (water in play): 'compassion and imagination wash over us', 'emotional high water' - OK
Sun/Leo card (fire in play): heat, spark, burn - OK
weather-as-mood on a Mercury card (mismatch): cut

seriesContext.note: Whether an aspect is a single pass or part of a multi-hit series (slow planets re-contact through retrograde) is a CALCULATED fact from the ephemeris, supplied at runtime as facts.series = { index, count, throughLabel }. It renders as a short, voice-neutral line in the mechanics caption (the 'what this looks like in space' layer), NEVER hardcoded into the poetic card body, which stays free of fixed dates.
seriesContext.suppressed: When count is 1 (a single pass), render nothing. A single pass is not informative, so no line appears.
examples: Uranus trine Pluto (count 5) -> The first of five passes, running through May 2028.

conditionalBans.reason: The 'steady' word family is only allowed when 'stable', 'strong', or 'solid' appears before it in the card; otherwise use calm, solid, grounded, consistent, or sure.

shape.note: The card is an 8-beat template across two short paragraphs. Each beat is FILLED FROM A SOURCE; the writing sharpens the beat, it never invents astrology. This is the skeleton the generator fills.

beats.does: the pair's core energy as a felt collective statement, with the tone
beats.example: Belief is carrying a lot of weight right now, and mostly it serves us.

beats.does: name the aspect and what it does to us, element-matched
beats.example: With the Leo Sun trine Neptune in Aries, compassion and imagination wash over us before logic can sober us up.

beats.does: three DISTINCT lived things (no two overlapping) that show the effect
beats.example: A cause, a song, or a piece of art hits us long before anyone needs to argue for it.
Leo gives the vision a human heart; Neptune in Aries insists it's worth fighting for.
We are quicker to trust now, readier to give up our own ground for something larger.

beats.does: name the gift and the shadow together
beats.example: Beautiful instincts, and a nice distraction from looking too closely at the math.

beats.does: the sharp aphorism plus its consequence, element-matched
beats.example: Feeling moved is not the same as being right, and emotional high water will carry a broken plan straight over the edge.

beats.does: two short lines: a truth, then its catch
beats.example: Inspiration is real. It's also a very comfortable place to avoid details.

planetTierRegister.moon: shared passing mood; felt, universal micro-moments (say yes, go quiet, a short reply)
planetTierRegister.mercury: shared mental/verbal pull; messages, wording, what gets said or left unsaid
planetTierRegister.venus: shared read on worth and care; who is valued, what a yes costs
planetTierRegister.mars: shared impulse to act, push, argue; heat looking for a target
planetTierRegister.sun: recognition and leadership out in the open; being seen, taking credit
planetTierRegister.jupiter: public promises and scale; the offer, the belief, what it can deliver
planetTierRegister.saturn: limits, rules, the record; what has to be earned or enforced
planetTierRegister.uranus: sudden breaks and disruption; the settled thing coming apart
planetTierRegister.neptune: blur between the story and the reality; what gets idealized or hidden
planetTierRegister.pluto: power and control underneath; who really decides, what stays hidden
planetTierRegister.chiron: old sore spots exposed by recognition or worth

modernObjects: a post that goes up without their name
moodCues: the small drop in the stomach
restlessness looking for somewhere to land

fail.reason: owner ban; use hold, pull, advantage
owner ban; use make the most of, help along

fail.term: the ones that require you to shrink or perform
require you to shrink or perform

fail.reason: template seam - weave both faces, do not label them
template seam - weave both faces, do not label them
naming the aspect geometry in the body
naming the elements as mechanics ('air-fire sextile'); element is felt, not labeled

warn.reason: fine for public/outer aspects, too stiff for Moon/soft ones
coaching/technical; prefer sensory or atmospheric ('reach us before logic gets a word in')
avoid bare 'loop' as a cycle comparison; use cycle. 'feedback loop' is fine.
corporate register; only for genuinely public aspects

humanJudgment: Vague 'things'/'thing' as filler is off, but idiomatic use ('get things done', 'the extra thing') is fine. Not machine-checked.
One reframe or catch per card, not two.
The close should be the shortest true sentence in the card.
exemplars: See examples.json entries with surface 'sky' and mode 'collective-aspect-card' (sourceId prefix 'sky-moon-'). Every exemplar must score clean against this file.
